name: Biological Sciences PhD
institution: Missouri University of Science and Technology
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Recommended fall doctoral deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Rolling admissions continue after recommended deadline; earlier filing improves admission/funding consideration.

english.toefl: 4.5; 80 for tests before January1,2026, as published
english.note: Central country list or degree from US, UK, Australia, New Zealand or Canada except Quebec can exempt proof. Additional English assessment applies to teaching appointments; PTE58/Cambridge176 also listed.

applicationFee.note: International on-campus fee $75; domestic $55. Fee waivers may be offered for attendance at specified in-person/virtual graduate events. Confirm event conditions and international eligibility before paying.

documents: Transcripts from all colleges/universities (unofficial for application; official after admission)
Statement of purpose (1,000 words or less)
requirements.note: Direct bachelor’s and master’s entry available. GRE explicitly required for Biological Sciences MS/PhD on current central page. Research statement, previous research examples/publications encouraged but not required.

funding.note: Competitive teaching assistantships are available for excellent applicants with an identified faculty mentor. No universal funding guarantee or current program stipend established.
